description: This file defines the PlatformError class which manages displaying an error dialog related to platform errors, specifically connection errors, in an Android application. It handles user interactions with the dialog and communicates responses back to native code.

classes.name: PlatformError
classes.description: Manages displaying an error dialog for platform errors and handles user responses.

methods.name: PlatformError
methods.description: Constructor initializing the PlatformError with activity holder, error type, and data.

methods.name: raise
methods.description: Displays the error dialog on the UI thread.

methods.name: showDialogOnUiThread
methods.description: Creates and shows the error dialog based on the error type.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on dialog buttons, such as retry or network settings.

methods.name: onDismiss
methods.description: Handles dialog dismissal and sends the response.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Informs native code of the user's response to the error dialog.
